name: @wildflowerhealthio/app-catalog-core-js
description: The schema of Wildflower's App Catalog, a HALO 2.0.0-DFT-preBallot App Catalog (https://simplifier.net/guide/halo/Home/HALO-Components/App-Catalog) published at `https://app-catalog.wildflowerhealth.io/apps`: `Catalog` (the document), `App` (one application object, a `SmartApp` or a `BackendService`) with its `Contact`, `Publisher`, `PreassignedCredentials` and `Intent`, the closed `Tag` list with its `TAG_LABELS`, and where the catalog is published (`CATALOG_PATH`, `CATALOG_JSON_PATH`, `CATALOG_URL`). No React, no DOM.
